N23813089.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains U.S. Embassy reporting on President Emílio Garrastazu Médici and the executive branch in Brazil, centered on his first press interview in March 1970. Médici addressed the military government’s political direction, rejecting the claim that he had promised a full restoration of democracy and expressing doubt that Institutional Act No. 5 (AI-5) would soon be revoked.
